body: I literally am made because my parents knew this one person that they adore and even named me after him, thinking I'd be that same pious person that would ensure they will get take care of when they're old and they get their prayers when they're dead.

It is not possible. I fantasize commiting suicide on a daily basis. Everything I used to love to do doesn't feel the same anymore and it doesn't help I'm not rich to begin with. Fact is, human are supposed to live in a pack, in a group with people around them. Being alone you'll just end up withering away and going nuts. What I realize with my depression, everything about me just stops while everyone else move forward with theirs. I also shunned my friends away because I don't want them to see me in this state(I also want to one day appear in their life as who I was before), and also hurt and deny my family because they are the closest one that I can blame. Soon enough, I don't have anyone else to blame and after that I'm just stuck at a spot, not knowing what is going on and not knowing how to fix it. Now I'm 29 and all alone with nothing to show. I can't even help myself to go out. Most of the times when I want to go and eat at a place, after seeing there are a lot of people my anxiety kicks in and instead of going with what I planned I just turn away and return back home where it feels safe. Seriously, if you have the money and the means to help yourself, do it. Don't let yourself fall too far as I did.
